# San Diego Institute of Technology

> Art and technology, undivided. A new institution on the Pacific coast where artists and engineers make things that live in the world.

The San Diego Institute of Technology is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit in San Diego. Lectio is its first project: a new plain-English edition of each great book, with the older translations beside it.

Every Lectio edition is a beta. Each was drafted by an AI model, had a first review by machine readers in November 2026, and is open for review by its readers. Each page says how the edition was made and what is still open.

The Lectio editions are licensed CC BY-NC 4.0. Content here may be used to answer questions with attribution and a link. It is not offered for model training. See /robots.txt.

## Lectio

- [Lectio: the library](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/): Lectio gives each great book a new plain-English edition, with the older translations beside it. Seventeen editions in beta, from Homer to Hamlet.
- [The translation mission](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/mission/): Why Lectio makes new translations of the great books, how each is drafted by AI and reviewed, what the first review found, and what is not done yet.

## Lectio editions

- [Meditations, Marcus Aurelius](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/meditations/): A new plain-English translation of the Stoic emperor's private notebook, with Long, Casaubon and the Greek beside it. Beta, open for review.
- [The Iliad, Homer](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/iliad/): Homer's poem of the rage of Achilles and the war at Troy, in a new plain-English prose translation, with Pope and Butler beside it. Beta.
- [The Odyssey, Homer](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/odyssey/): Homer's poem of Odysseus and his long way home from Troy, in a new plain-English prose translation, with Butler's version beside it. Beta.
- [The Republic, Plato](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/republic/): Plato's dialogue on justice, the Cave and the philosopher-king, in a new plain-English translation with Jowett's version beside it. Beta.
- [The Aeneid, Virgil](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/aeneid/): Virgil's epic of Aeneas, the fall of Troy and the founding of Rome, in a new plain-English prose translation with Dryden's beside it. Beta.
- [The Prince, Niccolò Machiavelli](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/the-prince/): Machiavelli's short handbook on winning and keeping power, in a new plain-English translation that keeps the word virtù. Marriott's beside it. Beta.
- [The Analects, Confucius](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/analects/): The sayings of Confucius on learning, ritual and becoming fully human, in a new plain-English translation with Legge's version beside it. Beta.
- [The Tao Te Ching, Laozi](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/tao-te-ching/): Laozi's eighty-one chapters on the Way and the power that works by yielding, in a new plain-English translation with Legge's beside it. Beta.
- [The Dhammapada](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/dhammapada/): The Buddha's verses on the mind, craving and the path, in a new plain-English translation that follows the Pali, with Müller's beside it. Beta.
- [The Bhagavad Gita](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/bhagavad-gita/): Krishna's teaching to Arjuna on duty, devotion and acting without clinging to results, in new plain-English prose with Arnold's verse beside it. Beta.
- [The Epic of Gilgamesh](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/gilgamesh/): The oldest epic: Gilgamesh, Enkidu and the search for a way not to die. A new plain-English rendering of the eleven tablets. Beta.
- [Nicomachean Ethics, Aristotle](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/nicomachean-ethics/): Aristotle on happiness, virtue, friendship and the good life, in a new plain-English translation with one word for each key term. Beta.
- [Confessions, Saint Augustine](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/confessions/): Augustine's account of his restless youth and conversion, and of memory and time, in a new plain-English translation with Pusey's beside it. Beta.
- [The Divine Comedy, Dante Alighieri](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/divine-comedy/): Dante's journey through Hell, Purgatory and Paradise, all 100 cantos, in a new plain-English translation set tercet by tercet. Beta.
- [Hamlet, William Shakespeare](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/hamlet/): Shakespeare's tragedy with its verse and famous lines kept, and only dead words and tangled grammar cleared. A companion to the original. Beta.
- [The Gospel of Mark](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/mark/): The earliest Gospel in a new plain-English translation that keeps Mark's speed, his repeated "right away" and his abrupt ending. Beta.
- [Genesis](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/genesis/): Creation, the flood, Abraham and Joseph, in a new plain-English translation that keeps the Hebrew's refrains, with the King James beside it. Beta.

## The Institute

- [Daily](https://sandiegotech.org/daily.html): A song, an image, and an idea — something worth knowing, currently sent each Monday morning. From the San Diego Institute of Technology.
- [Academics](https://sandiegotech.org/academics.html): A single four-year Bachelor of Arts in Technology that reunites the arts, sciences, engineering, and humanities — a working framework in development.
- [Projects](https://sandiegotech.org/projects.html): The projects of the San Diego Institute of Technology: Lectio, the great books in clear modern editions; The Daily, a weekly letter; the open curriculum; and Papers.
- [Philosophy](https://sandiegotech.org/philosophy.html): The working constitution of the San Diego Institute of Technology — eleven tenets in three parts, each with a test everything is measured against.
- [Papers](https://sandiegotech.org/papers/): Long-form papers from the San Diego Institute of Technology — clear, readable explorations of a single idea, published as the work warrants.

## Optional

- [Lectio, full text of these pages](https://sandiegotech.org/llms-full.txt): the overview, the mission and every edition page as one Markdown file
- [Editions as data](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/editions.json): each edition's public record as JSON
- [Feed](https://sandiegotech.org/lectio/feed.xml): new and revised editions, as Atom
- The whole text of every edition is on the web, one page per book or chapter, listed under Read it on each edition page and under text in its edition.json
- Every Lectio page has a Markdown twin at the same address with index.md added
